<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template for sulfonamide formation, I will search the template catalog for reactions that form an S‑N bond in the forward direction. This should retrieve templates that, when applied retrosynthetically, break the S‑N bond to give an amine and a sulfonyl chloride. I will request a few results.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C1=CC=C(C=C1)S(=O)(=O)N", 
    "bonds_formed": ["S-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
